name: BWild Grain Free Large Breed Cat Paté Buffalo

variants.name: Buffalo 100 g
variants.about_this_item: Monge Natural Superpremium Bwild Grain Free Buffalo with Vegetables is a complete and balanced food for kittens (>2 months) and adult large breed cats . The formula uses alternative carbohydrate sources such as green beans and carrots and buffalo meat, a naturally rich source of protein with high biological value. The recipe is also enriched with Xyloligosaccharides (XOS), a new generation of prebiotics to support intestinal health. The content of glucosamine and chondroitin sulphate supports the joints of large-breed cats .
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Buffalo (26%), pork liver, chicken meat, fresh carrots (2%), dried tomato pomace, dried green beans 1% (equal to 4.3% of fresh beans), minerals, salmon oil (1%), hydrolysed animal protein, xylo-oligosaccharide (XOS 0.1%), yucca schidigera (0.1%), spirulina, glucosamine (0.019%), chondroitin sulphate (0.01%).

Analytical constituents: Crude protein: 10%, Crude fibre: 1%, Crude fat: 5.5%, Crude ash: 2.3%, Moisture: 79%, Calcium/Phosphorus Ratio: 1.2.

Additives: NUTRITIONAL ADDITIVES: Vitamin D3 294 IU/kg, Vitamin E (all-rac-alpha-tocopheryl-acetate) 10.5 mg/kg, Selenium (Sodium selenite 0.05 mg/kg) 0.02 mg/kg, Manganese (manganous sulphate monohydrate 7.5 mg/kg) 2.4 mg/kg, Zinc (Zinc oxide 35 mg/kg): 28.1 mg/kg, Copper (Copper (II) sulphate pentahydrate 3 mg/kg) 0.76 mg/kg, Iron (Iron (II) sulphate monohydrate 25 mg/kg) 8.22 mg/kg, Iodine (Calcium iodate anhydrous 0.4 mg/kg) 0.26 mg/kg, taurine 1,400 mg/kg.
